steps.label: runtime_stats
steps.sub: duration, CPU, reads per plan, per interval

code:
SELECT qt.query_sql_text, q.query_id, p.plan_id,
    rs.avg_duration, rs.count_executions
FROM sys.query_store_query AS q
JOIN sys.query_store_query_text AS qt
  ON q.query_text_id = qt.query_text_id
JOIN sys.query_store_plan AS p ON q.query_id = p.query_id
JOIN sys.query_store_runtime_stats AS rs
  ON p.plan_id = rs.plan_id;
caption: This history survives a service restart — the plan cache doesn't.
